name: h2o-supersaturation
meaning: ideal partial pressure divided by water saturation pressure

name: h2o-dewpoint-k
meaning: inverse water saturation temperature at local vapor partial pressure

name: nucleation-applied-m3-s
meaning: applied J after local vapor limiter

name: droplet-radius-m
meaning: mean monodisperse radius; zero where no droplets

name: source-limiter-flag
meaning: local vapor or liquid inventory limiter active

name: model-risk-flag
meaning: invalid values or temperatures outside declared useful region

name: nucleation-raw-m3-s
meaning: ICCT J before inventory limiter; finite cap may apply

name: liquid-mass-fraction-beta
meaning: liquid loading divided by one plus loading

name: birth-mass-applied-kg-m3-s
meaning: critical seed mass times applied J

name: energy-source-temperature-jacobian-w-m3-k
meaning: nonpositive dSe/dT at frozen ADJUST state; zero across a major branch switch

name: energy-source-cached-w-m3
meaning: physical energy source cached at the same ADJUST state as mass sources
